# TokenVector.Numerics

> High-performance tensor computing, linear algebra, autograd, optimization, signal processing, quantum, astrodynamics, finance, and computational physics library for .NET 8 — published natively in the **TokenVector language** standard library (`.tkv`, spec TV-1001) with full numeric-surface coverage (354/354 audited functions).

TokenVector.Numerics is the numerics runtime of the [TokenVector](https://github.com/nguyenhungtran18/TokenVector) language ecosystem. Version 1.1.0 (September 24, 2026), MIT license, .NET 8 LTS, NuGet package `TokenVector.Numerics`.

## Docs

- [README (English)](README.md): overview, feature matrix, verification commands
- [README (Tiếng Việt)](README_VI.md): bản tiếng Việt của README

- [User Guide (Tiếng Việt)](USER_GUIDE_VI.md): bản tiếng Việt của hướng dẫn sử dụng

- [Test Report (Tiếng Việt)](TEST_REPORT_VI.md): bản tiếng Việt của báo cáo kiểm thử

## Language Specification

- [TokenVector Syntax Spec (English)](TOKENVECTOR_SYNTAX_SPEC.md): formal TV-1001 grammar — `import tv`, `tv.array/tensor`, `tv.linalg/autograd/nn/optim`, `tkvc main.tkv -r TokenVector.Numerics.dll -o app.exe`
- [TokenVector Syntax Spec (Tiếng Việt)](TOKENVECTOR_SYNTAX_SPEC_VI.md): bản tiếng Việt của đặc tả ngữ pháp

## TokenVector Standard Library (.tkv)

- [Stdlib README](src/tokenvector/README.md): module map (27 `.tkv` modules ≈ 12.1k lines), TV-1001 translation conventions, coverage tables, benchmark tables
- Modules: `core`, `engine`, `io`, `linalg`, `linalg_functions`, `ops`, `manipulation`, `grid`, `compare`, `autograd`, `neural`, `optimize`, `interpolation`, `poly`, `special`, `fft`, `signal`, `random`, `statistics`, `quantum`, `physics`, `astro`, `finance`, `spatial`, `geometry3d`, `crypto_graph`, `biology_robotics`
- Each module header lists its per-section source mapping and fidelity notes (Parallel.For/AVX2 collapse to scalar loops; `tkvc -O parallel -O simd` restores them)

## Verification (reproducible)

- [Smoke harness](tests/tokenvector/tkv_harness.py): AST syntax gate (TV-1001 constructs only) + standalone `tv.*` runtime; runs `tests/tokenvector/smoke_tests.tkv` — current: passed=175, failed=0
- [Coverage audit](tests/tokenvector/numpy_coverage_audit.py): cross-checks the stdlib surface against an independent numeric-library reference (354 library functions audited) — current: matched=354 (100%), missing=0 (script filename kept for reproducibility)
- [Benchmark](tests/tokenvector/benchmark_vs_numpy.py): numeric parity across matmul/add (0.0), SVD (1.1e-14), FFT (≈5e-12); interpreter-level speed ratios reported with the `tkvc`-compiled caveat
- Runtime test suite: `dotnet test TokenVector.Numerics.sln -c Release` — current: 84/84 passed

## Packaging

- [dist/bin/](dist/bin/): standalone `TokenVector.Numerics.dll` (net8.0) + XML docs + spec/README copies + brand icon
- [dist/nuget/](dist/nuget/): `TokenVector.Numerics.1.1.0.nupkg` (README + icon embedded) and `.snupkg` symbols
- [dist/TokenVector.Numerics-v1.1.0-Release.zip](dist/TokenVector.Numerics-v1.1.0-Release.zip): full release bundle (binaries + stdlib + toolchain + packages)
